load_passage_scorer: load a passage scorer by name from config using load_passage_scorer
score_passages_dummy: score passages with a fixed default score using DummyPassageScorer
score_passages_lookup: score passages by looking up precomputed scores from a file using LookupPassageScorer
score_passages_learnt: score passages in batches using a pretrained sequence classification model via LearntPassageScorer
tokenize_texts: tokenize a list of text passages into model-ready input tensors using LearntPassageScorer
